text:
kai: spun up a tiny NextJS starter showing LlamaIndex + Redwood embeddings. saw users hit 'unrecognized snapshot' when SSR builds persisted index then client edge loader failed to load it. repo: https://git.company/oss/next-llama-mini
emily: quick repro? SSR path writes snapshot, edge path reads it on navigation?
kai: exactly. server persists snapshot to KV under 'kb-site', client edge loader throws and rebuilds index causing repeated embedding work.
sdk-bot: recorded runtime versions: server @redwood/inference@0.14.0, edge @redwood/inference@0.13.1
pat: sounds like serializer/sdks mismatch. any KV logs?
kai: KV get returns blob size 158kb, loader error: "IndexLoadError: unknown serializer v0x" in edge logs. snippet:
```n2026-03-24T09:03:01Z INFO kv.get kb-site/snap size=158k
2026-03-24T09:03:01Z ERROR IndexLoadError: unknown serializer v0x
```n
maya: workaround: force serializer in sample: idx.persist({ serializer: 'compat.json' }) and load with same option. also pin exact SDK version in package.json to avoid caret pulling divergent releases.
emily: for DX, add a postinstall validator: compare installed @redwood/inference versions for node/edge targets and warn. also add a tiny e2e test that does SSR persist -> edge load -> assert no rebuild via span counts.
kai: will send PR with pins, serializer example, postinstall check, and e2e. tagging @maya for review.
pat: also propose SDK change: when loading snapshot, emit hint with serializer type and SDK version to surface parity issues to users.
kai: agreed. marking as medium DX. PR inbound.
